memory_update.text: VECO should remain a priority underfollowed candidate for the optical_interconnect_epitaxy_tools node because it has direct company-disclosed InP laser equipment orders tied to 800G/1.6T hyperscale transceiver manufacturing.

AXTI should be tracked as a substrate-side candidate, but later layers must stress-test export-permit risk, China manufacturing concentration, revenue materiality and whether InP demand is durable beyond a short inventory cycle.
POET belongs in the speculative_shadow lane: named design-win evidence exists, but survival requires proof of volume production, customer purchase commitments and material revenue.

For this node, the most actionable US-listed upstream chain appears to be: hyperscaler AI bandwidth demand -> 800G/1.6T transceivers -> EML/CW lasers and optical engines -> InP substrates and epitaxy -> MOCVD/IBD/wet-process tools.

Aixtron appears highly relevant to MOCVD/compound-semiconductor epitaxy but was not included in the candidate list because this pass prioritized US-listed/common-share accessibility; verify whether US OTC ADR treatment is acceptable for future Serenity universe passes.

node: Optical interconnect and compound-semiconductor epitaxy tool chain: lasers, photonics, InP/GaAs epitaxy, and MOCVD/deposition tools
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a compact US-listed universe around the optical-interconnect upstream chokepoint. The strongest underfollowed mapping is not the visible optical-module layer alone, but the production inputs needed for 800G/1.6T: InP laser manufacturing tools, InP/GaAs substrates, and optical-engine integration. VECO is the cleanest US-listed equipment candidate in this pass because it disclosed more than $250M of InP-laser manufacturing equipment orders tied to 800G/1.6T hyperscale data-center transceivers. AXTI is a direct substrate candidate with company statements linking InP substrate demand to AI interconnects, but export-permit/geopolitical risk must be tracked. POET is a smaller speculative optical-engine candidate with design-win evidence but needs volume/revenue verification. LITE is included as a high-attention reference anchor for InP laser demand and customer-pull verification rather than the primary underfollowed alpha lane.
